description: Forward-model opportunity: 'mitosis_evaluate_verdict' is acted on / observed but NOT predicted. Proposed model: P(vessel_mitosis_evaluate returns FAVORABLE | staged-change features: lines changed, typecheck-clean-on-stage, scope) — predict before staging/cutover dispatch. Payoff: verdict-miscalibration scan; lets the loop avoid staging changes predicted UNFAVORABLE. Adding it follows the predict→validate→residual template (like the live cost model) — every prediction becomes a free residual-detector, widening detectability.
